description.content:
Call this endpoint to enroll a specified user into your rewards program.
Required scopes:  `user:write`
Note: `Maximum of 100 users can be created per request`.

Call this endpoint to update the details on a specified user.
Required scopes: `user:update`

Call this endpoint to delete a specified enrolled user from the rewards program and Kard's system. Users can be re-enrolled into rewards by calling the [Create User](/2024-10-01/api/users/create) endpoint using the same `id` from before.
Required scopes: `user:delete`

Call this endpoint to fetch the details on a specified user.

Required scopes:  `user:read`

Call this endpoint to enroll a specified user into your rewards program. Learn more about the [Enrolling Users](https://github.com/kard-financial/kard-postman#a-cardholders) flow based on your use case here.
Required scopes: `user:write`

Call this endpoint to create a card that a specified user enrolled in rewards will use to make purchases and earn rewards.
Required scopes: `user:write`

description.content:
Call this endpoint to delete a specified enrolled user from the rewards program and Kard's system. Users can be re-enrolled into rewards by calling the [Create User](/legacy/api/users/create-user) endpoint using the same `referringPartnerUserId` from before. Deleting a user will remove all the user fields for that specific user from Kard’s system.
Required scopes: `user:delete`
